cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Co-Sign This
cards.instruction: Get someone to help by making them an official participant who shares responsibility for the outcome.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. I've made you co-organizer of Saturday's school trip. Can you approve the bus route?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I only volunteered to drive. Your route misses the museum.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. Good catch. Correct it and initial it; then we both own the plan.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll fix it, but you explain any delays to the parents.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Together. I'll introduce you as our transport lead and take the questions beside you.

mechanism: A copies a crossed route as agreed planning and turns B corrections into official shared responsibility for the school trip.
confusable: D169 creates accountable participation; D167 redefines terms to keep a preferred outcome without shared role.
comparison: Barbecue replacement decisions versus explaining school-trip delays.
seedUse: Keep B route correction and parent-facing boundary as actual reasons for assigning the role.
